# Pinned static-analysis tooling for the nightly clang-tidy job and for local
# use:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements/analysis.txt
# A binary wheel, pinned exactly: a new release can add checks, and .clang-tidy's
# disabled list names the ones this version brought (docs/ci.md, "Nightly
# analysis"). Dependabot's pip ecosystem for /.github/requirements keeps this
# current.
clang-tidy==22.1.8
